$comment: Pins the interactive Second Brain agent model. additionalDirectories grants the agent access to Obsidian vaults outside this repo (set the path for your machine). The PreToolUse hook enforces per-agent RBAC on vault writes (backstop for the .claude/agents/<id>.md allowlists + docs/vault-schema.md); it defers for unknown/unenforced roles and for non-vault paths.
